 Best Picture-nominated thriller Inception starring Cillian Murphy is now streaming on Netflix
 Christopher Nolan's epic 2010 sci-fi heist thriller starring beloved Irish actor Cillian Murphy, 50, is now available to stream on Netflix along with another fan favorite film
 Add to preferred sources Julianna Salinas Showbiz & TV Reporter 15:12 ET, 05 Nov 2026 View 3 Images Inception is now streaming on Netflix (Image: NurPhoto via Getty Images) 
 Christopher Nolan's 2010 sci-fi heist thriller Inception, starring Cillian Murphy and Tom Hardy, is now streaming in the UK.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 The Best Picture-nominated film, featuring a star-studded ensemble cast, is now available to watch on Netflix . Inception was written and directed by the blockbuster filmmaker and stars Leonardo DiCaprio as a professional thief who steals information by breaking into his targets' subconscious minds, including Cillian Murphy's character. Tom Hardy, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Michael Caine, and Elliot Page also appear alongside the Irish actor in the film.
 Murphy, 50, previously explained why he was happy not to be starring in Nolan's latest film, The Odyssey , as Matt Damon took on the titular role of Odysseus.
 ‌ 
 READ MORE : Cillian Murphy defended by fans as he's accused of having plastic surgery READ MORE : Cillian Murphy's son is image of father even down to mannerisms says fans In the film, Don Cobb (DiCaprio) is a professional "extractor" who steals information from people's dreams and is tasked with performing "inception," planting an idea into the subconscious of corporate heir Robert Fischer Jr. (Murphy) in exchange for his criminal record being wiped clean and returning home to his children.
 Nolan's 2010 blockbuster hit features an all-star Hollywood cast, including Leonardo DiCaprio, Cillian Murphy, Tom Hardy, Ken Watanabe, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Marion Cotillard, Elliot Page, Tom Berenger, Dileep Rao, and Michael Caine.
 View 3 Images Inception is now streaming on Netflix (Image: Warner Bros. Pictures) 
 ‌ 
 Inception was nominated for 8 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Original Screenplay, Art Direction, and Original Score. The film won Best Cinematography, Best Sound Editing, Best Sound Mixing, and Best Visual Effects at the 83rd Academy Awards in 2011.
 The film boasts an impressive 86% critics' score on Rotten Tomatoes, along with a 91% audience score on the review aggregator.
 ‌ 
 Speaking about his character in the film, Murphy described him as "a petulant child who requires a lot of attention from his father," adding that "he has everything he could ever want materially, but he's deeply lacking emotionally." Fans have raved about his 'phenomenal' performance in Inception over the last 15 years , with many deeming it one of his best roles to date.
 View 3 Images Cillian Murphy stars in Inception
 ‌ 
 Inception, however, isn't the beloved Irish actor's first collaboration with Nolan. The beloved Irish actor originally auditioned for the role of Bruce Wayne/Batman in the 2005 film Batman Begins, which ultimately went to British actor Christian Bale.
 Nolan was reportedly so impressed by Murphy's audition that he was cast as the film's iconic villain, Dr. Jonathan Crane/Scarecrow, kicking off their decades-long working relationship, which includes films like Dunkirk and Oppenheimer.
 Murphy went on to win the Oscar for Best Actor in a Leading Role for his performance as J. Robert Oppenheimer in Nolan's epic biographical drama Oppenheimer in 2024.
 Along with Inception, Nolan's 2014 film Interstellar, starring Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain, and Michael Caine, is also streaming on Netflix, making for an epic double feature for a movie night at home.
